import hashlib,json
root=Path(__file__).parent.resolve();rapid=root/'host/tools/performance/rapid';changes=[]
def patch(name,replacements):
 p=rapid/name;before=p.read_text();after=before
 for old,new in replacements:
  assert old in after,(name,old);after=after.replace(old,new)
 (root/(name+'.original')).write_text(before);p.write_text(after)
 changes.append({'file':str(p),'originalSha256':hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),'adaptedSha256':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest(),'replacements':replacements})

(root/'validation-adaptation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Attempt-local async file capture and explicit version2 C-cache report validation; no compiler pipeline changes and no rewritten build reports.','changes':changes,'captureHelper':{'file':str(rapid/'native-file-capture.mjs'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256((rapid/'native-file-capture.mjs').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}},indent=2)+'\n')

limitations: The matrix uses unchanged workers from the same checked Bend source, not the handwritten TypeScript compiler.
Initial checking/C emission uses the pinned upstream compiler; native output is JavaScript.
Node flags bound JS processes; they do not impose a 4GiB native heap limit.
Attempt-local asynchronous capture avoids pipe-based process supervision and is recorded with exact source. The production promotion is limited to build-report verification/timing.
Cache identity includes preprocessing, compiler and build tool hashes but assumes stable system linker/libraries.
Stage2 equality is byte equality to the checked integration stage; the separate final fixed-point proof establishes any stage2/stage3 fixed-point claim.
